notes.title: MEMENTO MORI'S 1 YEAR ANNIVERSARY (Thank You)
notes.content: [h1][u][b]A Message from the Wolfware Studios Team[/b][/u][/h1][p][b]We would like to take a moment to share our deepest appreciation and heartfelt thanks to every single person who has played Memento Mori over the past year. Your support has meant more to us than words can fully express.[/b][/p][p][b]When we first began this journey, we simply wanted to create something we loved — a project born from passion, creativity and countless hours of dedication. We never imagined the incredible community that would form around it. The love, encouragement and feedback we’ve received from all of you have truly blown us away and it’s been both humbling and inspiring to see our work resonate with so many people.[/b][/p][p][b]As of [u]August 14th 2025[/u], Memento Mori officially celebrates its first anniversary. It’s a milestone that would not have been possible without you — our players, supporters and friends. Whether you’ve been with us since day one or just joined our journey recently, you are a part of this story.[/b][/p][p][b]We hope you will continue to champion small indie teams like ours. Your support can make all the difference, helping creative voices survive, grow and bring new ideas to life. Just as you’ve done for us, you have the power to help keep the dream alive for many others.[/b][/p][p][b]From the bottom of our hearts — thank you. Keep smiling, keep creating your own stories and most importantly, [u]keep being unapologetically you[/u].[/b][/p][p][b]With love and gratitude, [/b][/p][p][b]Shea Kelly & Alekzandar Voynikov[/b][/p]

notes.title: The Making Of Memento Mori (Thank you for 2,000 downloads)
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone[/b] it’s Shea Kelly, on behalf of myself and Alex. We want to thank you for getting our game passed the 2,000 download number. We wanted to say thank you, so we decided to make a PDF file that you can read discussing ‘the making of Memento Mori’ and what we have done in the past as well as will continue to do in the future. In this book you will be able to learn about:

[list]
[*]Before ‘Memento Mori’
[*]Planning Phase
[*]Production Starts
[*]Spreading The Word
[*]Lead Up To Release 
[*]After Release 
[*]What ‘Memento Mori’ Means To Us
[/list]
[u][b]You are able to find the PDF in your library once you click on Memento Mori. It will be located above the achievements[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014244/b88974fb4be3b71fe104021787fc7ea7ce334a5e.png[/img]

We hope you keep playing our game and keep enjoying it as much as we enjoyed making it. That’s all for us. For the final time, until we get to 3,000 downloads, thank you this means the world to us.

[b]THIS IS 100% FREE[/b]

notes.title: Memento Mori Speedruns
notes.content: Hey everyone it’s been a while. Today's post aims to highlight the currently small but growing community of speedrunners dedicated to getting the best time in Memento Mori. Currently there are 3 categories of speedruns people can participate in ranging from Any%, All Achievements and lastly the newly added All Easter Eggs. At the current moment Any% is the most active category with the current world record being 5m: 19s:683ms. Anyone interested in attempting to snag the title of world record holder from Rafort2k can head over to [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Memento_Mori_PC]speedrun.com[/url] and give it a goal. P.S we would also like to thank the hard working moderators 🙏.

notes.title: Update Log
notes.content:
Hey everyone Alex here from Wolfware Studios. First up we want to thank you for all of the great reception we have garnered since the released of Memento Mori. With over 1000 downloads several art works and videos as well as reviews ranging from positive to negative, it’s hardly worth saying that it surpassed all expectations we had in terms of the release for our first title. 
Now moving on to the actual update:

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]
As stated as well as observed by us and people that have played the game in the past month, performance has been quite appalling for the game despite the limited graphics and size. Therefore, the last month since the release of the game has been spend by me learning as well as applying different optimisation techniques in order to bring the game to a performance standard of a modern game. Currently since the update, the game is able to smoothly run at stable 60fps all thorught the game except for two small sections (However they should not be noticeable). As this is the first ever game to frankly reach anywhere near the releasing stage I must admit I fully overlooked optimisation and want to apologise for that. Although it most likely still requires some attention as we are unable to test how the game runs on really low end pc we are hoping you as our community as well as any future players will provide feedback regarding the performance. 
	
[b]General Changes[/b]
Now moving away from the main part of the update thorough all of the videos that have been uploaded to YouTube of people playing the game we noticed several missing elements to even a game breaking bug that needed immediate attention. As most of these changes are quite minor and did not require as much of an attention as performance (besides the game breaking one) they will be listed under the general changes section.       
•	Placed missing guitars inside apartment 2 to 4 
•	Placed missing sofa pillows in reflection apartment 
•	Made it so players are able to use both escape and the “Resume” Button to leave the Pause menu. 
•	Fixed misplaced wall in reflection house getting rid of a weird gap. 
•	Fixed walking animation and sound playing after interacting with TV in the forest. 
•	Fixed walking animation and sound playing after interacting with bookcase leading to the Easter egg room. 
•	Fixed tiny adjacent gaps going across the mountain. 
       
[b]Game breaking bugs[/b] 
Although only possible in the second repeating apartment players were able to grab the next key before the door behind them is triggered and closed by a collider. This was caused due to my negligence that people would try to close the door behind them only after they had picked up the second key causing the event of the door to consume the key you had leaving you softlocked inside the second apartment unable to progress with the game. In order to fix this issue I revisited the code and forced the event of the locked door to trigger only ones, meaning it cannot use up more than one key. This issue was pointed out through one of our testers as well as a YouTuber who played through the game. However it is quite a weird sequence so most likely only a few people would have noticed it.   

[b]Conclusion[/b]
This concludes the first update of the game and once again we would like to thank everyone who spared sometime of their day to play, review as well as upload any form of content of the game on social media or the steam community tab. We have watched all of them and could not express the appreciation we have to all of you.
